comments.author: @lasade69
comments.text: If u shop for chocolate or chocolate flavoured candy u really would need to compare the cocoa percentage. Hersheys so called chocolate contains 11% cocoa (which is 1% higher than the FDAs minimum requirement). BUT the cocoa percentage of the hersheys milk chocolate is not printed on the bars package.European milk chocolate must contain a minimum of 25% cocoa, but usually contains min. 30% (milk chocolate). Chocolate percentage must be printed on the package of a European chocolate bar. Beware that products called 'chocolate candy' (usually chocolate flavoured) contains far less if any cocoa (products labelled as chocolate candy do not need to meet the FDA required minimum amount for US chocolate of 10% cocoa). So always opt for DARK chocolate, or imported milk chocolate.
